kill_gate_executable_20260814.falsifiability_self_test: A result that KILLS: select (iter_bm25) is CPU and O(L) -- 117.7 ms at 128k, paid identically by both arms (A02 section 4). At C=8 with one selector worker that is 8 x 117.7 = 941.6 ms of serial CPU per batch, EXCEEDING comem's entire 677.9 ms GPU read. If C=8 is bottlenecked on that shared serial CPU stage, both arms' p99 is dominated by an identical term and Delta collapses below 123.2 ms -> K1 fires -> thesis dead. P2.2 independently records the CPU path as 'GIL-bound single-copy loop', so this is a live mechanism. A result that PASSES: if C=8 is GPU-read-bound, queue wait scales with service time, the cheaper 24-layer arm drains faster, and the p99 gap AMPLIFIES. Both branches are physically plausible from data already on disk.
